logger.doc:name: Log Customer Profile Request
logger.message: Process Layer: Fetching profile for Customer ID: #[attributes.uriParams.customerId]

http:request.doc:name: Call SAPI GET Contact By ID

logger.doc:name: Log SAPI Response Status
logger.message: Process Layer: SAPI customer lookup returned HTTP status #[vars.backendStatusCode]

logger.doc:name: Log Customer Lookup Failure
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer profile lookup failed for ID #[vars.customerId]. Backend status: #[vars.backendStatusCode]
Process Layer: No customer profile found for ID #[vars.customerId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "failed", errorCode: "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND", message: "Customer profile with ID '" ++ (vars.customerId default "") ++ "' does not exist.", errorDescription: "No customer record was returned by the System API.", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Customer Profile Success
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer profile found successfully for ID #[vars.customerId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "success", message: "Customer profile retrieved successfully.", data: { contactId: payload.data.contactId default vars.customerId, firstName: payload.data.firstName default "", lastName: payload.data.lastName default "", email: payload.data.email default "", accountId: payload.data.accountId default "" } }

logger.doc:name: Log Profile Flow Completion
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer profile retrieval flow completed with HTTP status #[vars.httpStatus default 200]
